listenerInvestigation.observation: Stock CLI's bind-address does not constrain its wildcard RPC/pubsub/faucet listeners. Early diagnostic runs used loopback RPC requests but were not in a private network namespace; those validators were stopped. Final runs require a verified namespace containing only lo and no external routes.
